title: 49ers’ Day 3 NFL draft sleepers include receiver, edge, safety

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers’ Day 3 NFL draft sleepers include receiver, edge, safety
sources.description: The 49ers have a brief-but-busy afternoon ahead on Day 3 of the NFL draft. As of Sunday, they hold four selections Saturday, all of which land in the fourth round.
